turkish_ad_hosts.name: Turkish Ad Hosts by Ali Beyaz

bkrucarci_turk_adlist.name: bkrucarci turk-adlist
bkrucarci_turk_adlist.reason: Its ShareAlike 3.0 terms are not folded into GPL aggregate outputs; use the original list directly or review individual domains independently.

turk_adfilter.name: Turk-AdFilter
turk_adfilter.reason: Its regional Lite output also contains many non-DNS rules; DNS-safe extraction and provenance audit are needed before import.

adguard_filters.name: AdGuard Filters / Mobile Ads Filter
adguard_filters.reason: Rich Adblock syntax includes cosmetic, scriptlet and request rules. Kept as a research signal until the DNS-safe extractor and attribution path are independently audited.

goodbyeads.name: GoodbyeAds
goodbyeads.reason: Its documented source set contains mixed licensing including copyleft, non-commercial, no-license and all-rights-reserved inputs; therefore OSFilter does not wholesale-import it.

windows_spy_blocker.name: WindowsSpyBlocker
windows_spy_blocker.reason: Useful Windows telemetry research signal, but host data can intentionally disable Windows functionality and is kept out of default ad/tracking tiers.

adaway.name: AdAway default hosts
adaway.reason: Useful mobile-ad signal. Kept research-only because the active global tiers already cover this space and OSFilter wants a simpler attribution chain.

stevenblack_aggregate.name: StevenBlack unified hosts
stevenblack_aggregate.reason: Excellent architecture reference, but the aggregate includes multiple upstream licenses; OSFilter avoids importing the aggregate as a single relicensed source.
